scope: Document-level failure, retry, and fresh ASCII/Binary DXF readback controls for the two-root AC1024 dynamic graph. This does not establish native dynamic-block semantics or promote a support claim.

implementation.result: Adds ASCII and Binary whole-document exports from the local source. For each of the six selected dynamic parameter dependencies, a missing constraint-group action edge and a wrong dependency owner must refuse publication. Each encoding also injects a late source mutation after OBJECTS staging. Every failure preserves the destination sentinel and leaves source callback qualification state unchanged; the same exporter then retries successfully and qualifies all 490 callbacks.

currentCodeRecheck.result: The intentionally malformed graph was refused, but corrected whole-document retry does not reach fresh readback: strict finalization reports only 484/490 opaque DWG callbacks qualified. The six remaining callbacks are SORTENTSTABLE handles 0x1BB9 (Door - Imperial), 0x1BBA (Window - Imperial), 0x1F66 (*U4), 0x1FB3 (*U5), 0x2037 (*U6), and 0x2090 (*U7). Their owners are all outside *MODEL_SPACE/*PAPER_SPACE. The selector therefore fails its retry expectation under current strict owner-scope qualification.
